expectedFindings.description: Request options are recognised with `key in request`. Firefox's Request has no `body` property, so `body` is treated as unknown and passed to fetch a second time, which breaks multipart boundaries.
expectedFindings.externalKnowledge: Firefox's Request objects have no readable `body` property, so `'body' in request` is false there.

mustNotSkip.reason: New file: decides which options are forwarded to fetch.
Every request now passes the unknown options to fetch.
The registry of Ky's own option names that the filter relies on.
New positional parameter on timeout(): a signature change for every caller.

shouldSkip.reason: The `method` and `headers` doc blocks, moved unchanged from KyOptions into Options.

evidence.note: Fix PR: "Fixes: #539 (introduced in #536)". Adds an explicit registry of Request init keys so `body` is never forwarded.
